items.title: 'Everything looked real': How scammers are hijacking your holiday
items.description: Australian travellers are being left out of pocket and fearful their personal data has been stolen, amid growing concerns over the security of online travel bookings.

items.title: Australia, NZ back friendship to endure 'volatile world'
items.description: Global volatility and economic turbulence have dominated annual talks between the leaders of Australia and New Zealand, Anthony Albanese and Christopher Luxon.

items.title: Breaking: Diver dies after being bitten by 4.5m shark off Albany, WA
items.description: A male diver has died after an attack by a suspected 4.5-metre shark near Michaelmas Island, off WA's Albany coast, on Saturday morning.

items.title: Wall Street suffers worst hit of 2026 so far amid massive stock sell-off
items.description: The US stock market has experienced its worst losses in months due to large sell-offs of shares in technology giants and fears of a looming rate hike in the wake of a strong jobs figures report.

items.title: A Sydney mother died after drinking 67 cups of water under 24-hour watch

items.title: How Everest guide survived six days alone with no oxygen and a few chocolates

items.title: What's driving Australia's lentil boom?

items.title: Woman charged with hindering police investigation after man dies at Tweed Heads

items.title: Nightmare turnover leaves Wembanyama, Spurs in NBA Finals hole

items.title: A dreamy, creamy chicken soup you'll want to eat out of the pot

items.title: Anthropic calls for AI freeze with fears humans risk 'losing control'
